summary: A Tesla Model X with Autopilot engaged hit a concrete highway divider in Mountain View, California, and caught fire, killing the driver. Tesla said the driver's hands were not detected on the wheel in the seconds before the crash.

Logs showed the driver had received hands-on-wheel warnings. Critics note the system can lull drivers into overreliance.

Platform detection and ranking systems did not stop the campaign until researchers reported it, reflecting weak moderation of government-tied influence operations.
